hook.say: The morning post said OpenAI now uses Codex for CAD, PCB and simulation, with model usage up 23x. I went back in to check the numbers around it.

findings.label: BENCHMARK
findings.headline: Astra's score on OpenAI's newer BenchCAD 2.0
findings.detail: The Decoder reports the unreleased internal model scores 0.875 on the same test.
findings.evidence: GPT-6 Astra at its highest reasoning level hits 0.594.
findings.say: First, on OpenAI's newer BenchCAD 2.0, GPT-6 Astra at top reasoning scores 0.594. The unreleased internal model scores 0.875.

findings.label: COST
findings.headline: Astra output price per million tokens
findings.detail: GPT-6.1 Sol lists at $10 per million output tokens.

findings.evidence: $10/$50 per million input/output tokens for GPT-6 Astra, $2/$10 for GPT-6.1 Sol
findings.say: Second, Astra's output costs $50 per million tokens. GPT-6.1 Sol costs $10, so heavy CAD iteration gets expensive fast.

findings.label: HEAD-TO-HEAD
findings.headline: Astra's CAD Arena average across five platforms
findings.detail: Claude Fable 5.1 averaged 0.662 and had the best single SolidWorks score.
findings.evidence: CAD Arena's average (0.671 to 0.662), while Claude Fable 5.1 posted the best single SolidWorks score.
findings.say: Third, in an outside CAD Arena test across five platforms, Astra averaged 0.671. Claude Fable 5.1 was close at 0.662.

take.headline: Benchmarks are not your drawings.
take.say: My take: a benchmark score says little about your own drawings. Test the model on your real parts, and count the review rounds.

caption:
This morning: OpenAI says Codex and ChatGPT now help design CAD models, PCBs and simulations, with hardware-team usage up 23x. Usage is not proof of results.

I went back in. On OpenAI's BenchCAD 2.0, Astra scores 0.594. Output costs $50 per million tokens, versus $10 for GPT-6.1 Sol. In an outside CAD Arena test, Astra averaged 0.671 against 0.662 for Claude Fable 5.1.

My take: a benchmark score says little about your own drawings. Test the model on your real parts, and count the review rounds.

Comment REVIT and I will send you the details by DM.

Sources in the first comment.
